notes: Append new epochs; never edit a FROZEN/RETIRED entry's definition or thresholds. A material change is a new epoch with a new preregistration. effective_until is the only field that may be added to close an epoch.

setup.rule: completed directional 2 immediately after an inside 1 arms a watch; directional-2 high/low frozen before the next 30m watch window

trigger.rule: first strict break opposite the directional 2 = provisional reversal; same-direction first break = cancellation; equality does not count; simultaneous/unknown fails closed

target.diagnostic_endpoint: +1.0 directional-2 reference-range reach from exact IEX reversal timestamp (not a win/loss rule)

filters.capture: timely genuinely pre-armed IEX reversal only; existing OPTIONS_PAPER_V1 selector path unchanged; missing/stale quotes, replay mismatch or late capture fail closed
